entries.description: Harry and Lupin recall that a Grindylow in a tank stood in a corner of Lupin’s office on Harry’s first visit.
entries.model_notes: Recollection used for an identity check and accepted by Lupin; establishes tank-to-corner relationship but no size, window, floor or later survival of the fixture.

chapter_reviews.notes: Read complete chapter. Malfoy Manor and its security are not Hogwarts grounds; Charity Burbage’s employment, departure plans and Ministry transport discussions add no school-specific physical or spatial description. No manor feature is transferred to Hogwarts.

Read complete chapter in two non-truncated blocks, including entire Doge obituary and Skeeter interview. School biography, Mirror dialogue and disputed account of Dumbledore’s fall add no new Hogwarts physical or spatial details. Privet Drive and purported Lake Windermere scene are outside scope.

Read complete chapter. Privet Drive departure, blood protection, safe-house logistics and family dialogue contain no Hogwarts architectural or grounds description. Hagrid’s remembered door-smashing and general Dementor discussion belong elsewhere.

Read complete chapter in two blocks. Seven-Potter departure, aerial chase, vehicle defences and safe-house crash occur away from Hogwarts. No school grounds, lake or boundary is described; the muddy pond is the safe-house crash site, not the Hogwarts lake.

Read complete chapter in two blocks. Recorded remembered corner tank in Lupin’s school office. Tonks safe-house, Burrow, aerial route, wounds and Ollivander vision are outside Hogwarts site; protected hundred-yard safe-house boundary must not be assigned to Hogwarts.
